name: Methylenedioxydeschlorobupropion
summary: MDPT, also known as tertylone, tBuONE, or 3,4-methylenedioxy-N-tert-butylcathinone (MD-tBC), among other names, is a stimulant and recreational drug of the phenethylamine, cathinone, and MDxx families. It has been detected as a novel designer drug in the United Kingdom and New Zealand.

uses.text: MDPT, also known as tertylone, tBuONE, or 3,4-methylenedioxy-N-tert-butylcathinone (MD-tBC), among other names, is a stimulant and recreational drug of the phenethylamine, cathinone, and MDxx families. It has been detected as a novel designer drug in the United Kingdom and New Zealand.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Related cathinones can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, anxiety, sleeplessness and urges to redose, and bupropion-like drugs can cause seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。相關的卡西酮可能引起心跳過快、血壓上升、體溫過高、焦慮、失眠與追加使用的衝動，而類安非他酮藥物可能引發癲癇。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。相关的卡西酮可能引起心跳过快、血压上升、体温过高、焦虑、失眠与追加使用的冲动，而类安非他酮药物可能引发癫痫。

fact.en: Its long name says it is built like the antidepressant bupropion, which also has a bulky tert-butyl group on its nitrogen, but with bupropion's chlorine replaced by a methylenedioxy ring.
fact.zh: 它的長名稱說明它的結構和抗憂鬱藥安非他酮相似，氮原子上同樣接著龐大的第三丁基，只是把安非他酮的氯換成了亞甲二氧基環。
fact.zhHans: 它的长名称说明它的结构和抗忧郁药安非他酮相似，氮原子上同样接着庞大的第三丁基，只是把安非他酮的氯换成了亚甲二氧基环。
